status: protocol frozen before revised outcome inspection
implementation: CausalClusterer v2: immutable NEW/MERGE, UTC exact deadlines, max cluster 20, stable lexical ties, Issue.n starts at 0
timezone: Interpret naive San Diego timestamps as America/Los_Angeles, convert to UTC; month windows selected by original local calendar; features use UTC calendar

training.label_rule: same known workflow component positive; remaining sampled candidates treated as negative (weak supervision, not verified operational nonmatches)

threshold.selection: For each model family choose arrival threshold with highest certified positive-pair recall among points with decision proxy FMP <= 0.40, MERGE >= 1% of all records, and >= 100 adjudicable MERGEs. Break ties by higher F1 then higher threshold. If none feasible choose lowest proxy FMP among volume-eligible points, report infeasibility; never assume monotonicity.

selection_provenance: Band delta .5, gate h5, cutoff X10, D7 inherited from already viewed historical experiments; not new independent April selections. March threshold is recalibrated after implementation repair. May is exploratory. July is a newly frozen retrospective validation; no claim of prospective preregistration.

april_grid.role: fully enumerated development sensitivity, not selection of July primary comparison

analysis.confidence: Paired seed mean differences with 95% t intervals (df=4) on five shared scorer seeds; reflects fit-seed variability only.
analysis.mechanism: Both band and gate seed13 May+July pair gains/losses and directed wrong sets; trigger split, all-event denominators, common-source and service/age-stratified sensitivity.
analysis.candidate: Actual scored candidate snapshots, transitive graph relaxed upper bounds and cap-aware feasible static lower bound, frozen candidate comparisons clearly separated from causal end-to-end runs.
analysis.audit: Same initial state/model; output prefixes at identical UTC cutoff; ordered complete finalization events; three suffix perturbations and deliberately future-dependent inference positive control.
analysis.privacy: raw records, event IDs, trained models and Louisville annotations remain in local private directory; only aggregate outputs/code may publish.
